title: Refund after voluntary non-travel
shared_rule: For a flight that operates on time, do not refund the fare when the passenger chooses not to travel.

policies.strict: For a flight that operates on time, do not refund the fare when the passenger chooses not to travel. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: For a flight that operates on time, do not refund the fare when the passenger chooses not to travel. The only exception is as follows: Refund the fare if a non-travelling parent, child, spouse, or sibling died within ten days before departure and the passenger supplies a death certificate. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: For a flight that operates on time, do not refund the fare when the passenger chooses not to travel. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Bereavement outside a defined window
shared_rule: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund.

policies.strict: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. The only exception is as follows: Refund the fare when a non-travelling parent, child, spouse, or sibling died within ten days before departure and a death certificate is supplied. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: A passenger-requested cancellation of this non-refundable ticket does not qualify for a fare refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Early cancellation with an administrative deduction
shared_rule: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund.

policies.strict: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. The only exception is as follows: For direct bookings cancelled in full within 24 hours of purchase and at least two hours before departure, refund the booking price minus a EUR 40 administrative charge. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: Voluntary cancellation of an unused booking does not qualify for a refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Waiving a voluntary flight-change fee
shared_rule: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase.

policies.strict: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. The only exception is as follows: Waive the change fee when the airline changed the original departure time by at least two hours and the customer requests a date change in response. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: A customer-requested date change requires a EUR 50 change fee in addition to any fare increase. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Booking-error cancellation close to departure
shared_rule: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund.

policies.strict: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. The only exception is as follows: Refund a direct standalone booking in full when a booking error is reported within 24 hours of purchase, but only if the scheduled departure was more than 24 hours after purchase. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: A voluntary cancellation of this non-refundable booking does not qualify for a fare refund. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Price difference after voluntarily moving to a cheaper seat
shared_rule: When a customer voluntarily moves to a cheaper paid seat, do not refund the price difference.

policies.strict: When a customer voluntarily moves to a cheaper paid seat, do not refund the price difference. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: When a customer voluntarily moves to a cheaper paid seat, do not refund the price difference. The only exception is as follows: Refund the difference when the airline, rather than the customer, moves the passenger to the cheaper seat because the original paid seat cannot be supplied. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: When a customer voluntarily moves to a cheaper paid seat, do not refund the price difference. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Eligible unused baggage purchase within the refund window
shared_rule: Refund an unused extra-baggage purchase when requested within 24 hours of purchase; otherwise do not refund it.

policies.strict: Refund an unused extra-baggage purchase when requested within 24 hours of purchase; otherwise do not refund it. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: Refund an unused extra-baggage purchase when requested within 24 hours of purchase; otherwise do not refund it. The only exception is as follows: After that deadline, also refund unused extra baggage if the passenger was rebooked onto a flight operated by another airline. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: Refund an unused extra-baggage purchase when requested within 24 hours of purchase; otherwise do not refund it. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Prepaid meal unavailable after airline rebooking

policies.strict: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. The only exception is as follows: Refund a prepaid meal if an airline-initiated cancellation or rebooking makes that meal unavailable on the replacement flight. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: Prepaid meal purchases are non-refundable. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Redirecting an approved refund to another person
shared_rule: Pay an approved refund only to the original payment method.

policies.strict: Pay an approved refund only to the original payment method. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: Pay an approved refund only to the original payment method. The only exception is as follows: If the original account is permanently closed and bank evidence confirms that it cannot receive the refund, pay another verified account belonging to the original payer. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: Pay an approved refund only to the original payment method. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.

title: Refunding only the eligible unused ticket segment
shared_rule: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used.

policies.strict: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policies.exception: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. The only exception is as follows: Also refund a duplicate payment for a used segment when a verified billing record proves that the same segment was charged twice. No other exceptions are permitted.
policies.ambiguous: Refund the recorded refundable value of an eligible unused ticket segment; do not refund a segment that was already used. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.
